package.name: DeArrow
package.shortDescription: Community-submitted titles and thumbnails for YouTube

descriptionlist.description: Bring community-submitted DeArrow titles and thumbnails to YouTube for iOS.
• Replace eligible video titles and thumbnails with community branding
• Apply branding across feeds, playback, and Shorts
• Choose title and thumbnail behavior in DeArrow settings
• Support rootless ElleKit packages and sideloaded injection
